paragraphs.text: Sachi (SAH-chee) was an orochi shaman on Kamigawa . Daughter of Seshiro , granddaughter of Suzue , and sister of Sosuke , she became leader of the Kashi Tribe.
Sachi was the wisest daughter of Seshiro. She became chief of the Sakura-Tribe and was a leader of the Orochi with her brother when they were attacked by the Moonfolk of Oboro .
